Adds references from a source object to one or more target objects.

Automatically resolves the appropriate reference field based on the target kind

(e.g., requirement_refs for requirements, priority_plan_ref for priority plans,

or related_object_refs for general relationships).



Supports scalar (*_ref) and slice (*_refs) reference fields with duplicate
prevention,

cycle detection on related_object_refs, and scope-lock enforcement on sealed
priority plans.

  Add requirement to backlog item
  zqk object ref add BLI-001 REQ-001
  Add multiple criteria to requirement
  zqk object ref add REQ-001 CRIT-001 CRIT-002
  Add to specific field
  zqk object ref add BLI-001 PRI-001 --field priority_plan_ref

Usage:
  zqk object ref add [flags]

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --field string            Explicit reference field name on source object (e.g. priority_plan_ref, related_object_refs)
      --force                   Force reference addition (alias for override)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
      --override                Override scope-lock on sealed (active/in-progress) priority plans
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --reason-code string      Reason code required when using --override
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)
